title: npm run report presents the report of an earlier release build when the latest release build failed in the prebuild step
location: site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts:208-211 (the report is reset only at astro:build:start); package.json:15 (prebuild runs katex-assets.mjs, names.mjs and presets.mjs before Astro starts); scripts/report.mjs:36-41 (accepts any report with complete: true)
claim: The fix of P4-RT-12-04 marks the report incomplete when the Astro build starts and while the postbuild link check runs. A release build that fails in the prebuild never reaches Astro, so the previous release build's report stays complete and npm run report exits 0 with it.
expected: DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P4-toolchain: the postbuild holds the release report (P4-RT-12-04)': 'a release build is prebuild, the Astro build and the postbuild, and a failed release build is never presented as the release report'. SPEC 7.3: a release build 'prints a report of the open items and the pages that use them'; 7.7: npm run report gives 'the two content reports'. So after a failed RELEASE=1 npm run build, npm run report should exit 1, as it does after a postbuild failure.
observed: 1. RELEASE=1 npm run build: exit 0; report complete, generatedAt 2026-10-25T04:56:01.571Z. 2. Added <Unverified item="E4"> to M8 and a syntax error in packages/engine/src/rep.ts. 3. RELEASE=1 npm run build: exit 1 in the prebuild (presets.mjs: SyntaxError [ERR_INVALID_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX]). 4. npm run report: exit 0, 'report: open items report of 2026-10-25T04:56:01.571Z: 8 open items used on 9 pages, 0 unknown items'. The report still says complete: true, and E4's pages are /modules/m1-mutation/, /modules/m3-classification/ and /open-problem/, without /modules/m8-lie-algebras/, where the sources now use E4.
reproduction: From a clean clone of 006f50d plus this branch, after npm ci: bash redteam/rt12-p5/redteam-RT-12-stale-report.sh <clone> <logdir>. It prints steps 1 to 4 as above and restores the two edited files.
specRef: SPEC.md 7.3 (<Unverified>, the release report), 7.7 (npm run report); DECISIONS.md RT-FIX-P4-toolchain (P4-RT-12-04)
proposedFix: Make the first step of every release build command mark an existing report incomplete before anything can fail. For example, scripts/katex-assets.mjs, the first prebuild step, calls the openItemsReport.mjs writer when RELEASE is set. Alternatively, report.mjs could compare the report's buildId with a marker that the prebuild writes.

refute.citation: DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P4-toolchain: the postbuild holds the release report (P4-RT-12-04)' (also decisions/RT-FIX-P4-toolchain.md line 15): 'Reason: a release build is prebuild, the Astro build and the postbuild, and a failed release build is never presented as the release report'; DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b: a complete release report (P3-RT-12-06)': 'What the specification left open: what npm run report does after a failed release build (SPEC 7.3, 7.7 are silent)'; SPEC.md 7.3 'names.mjs ... runs at the start of every build'. These records support the finding's expected; nothing permits the behaviour.
refute.evidence: Everything was read at 006f50d (worktree detached there, git show only). SPEC 7.3 and 7.7 do not say what npm run report does after a failed release build, and neither section carries a [D] mark (the [D] headings in section 7 are 7.1, 7.6 and 7.9). Both report decisions say the SPEC is silent, so the standard is the logged decisions. The P3 decision states the question as 'what npm run report does after a failed release build' and answers that the report is refused. The P4 decision counts the prebuild as part of the release build, and SPEC 7.3 says names.mjs, a prebuild step, 'runs at the start of every build'. package.json has prebuild = katex-assets.mjs && names.mjs && presets.mjs. In unverifiedRegistry.ts the only reset is in 'astro:build:start', and the comment says 'a build that fails never reaches it [build:done]'. scripts/report.mjs refuses a report only when it is missing, its mode is not release, its .md is missing, or complete !== true. The P4 decision limits its scope to 'a release build that failed in postbuild' and records no choice for a prebuild failure. P0-A4 (DECISIONS.md line 289) says 'an existing release report is never touched by a preview build', but that covers preview builds only, not failed release builds. The reproducer read as text (redteam/rt12-p5/redteam-RT-12-stale-report.sh) asserts exactly the claim: a release build, then a prebuild syntax error in rep.ts, then npm run report exit 0. gate-G5.md row 9: report exit 1 because no release build ran at G5. It names gate commit 006f50d. No merge-P5-redteam report exists on disk. The P4 confirmer's leftover gap (round-p4/fixout/confirm-toolchain.json: a killed postbuild followed by a manual links.mjs) is a different cause. The known-and-decided list of P5-LENS-INSTRUCTIONS.md does not mention this. Ambiguity for the owner: read literally, the report shown after a prebuild failure belongs to the earlier release build that finished. report.mjs prints that build's generatedAt, and the failed build wrote no report. But no recorded sentence allows keeping that report after a later release build fails. Worktree left clean: git status --porcelain is empty, and there is no node_modules or site/dist.
refute.reason: not refuted: R1 failed because SPEC 7.3 and 7.7 are silent and P0-A4 lets an earlier release report survive only a preview build, not a failed release build. R2 failed because the finding quotes the P4 decision correctly, that decision counts the prebuild as part of the release build, and the P3 decision states the question as what npm run report does after a failed release build; the literal reading, that the report shown is the earlier finished build's, is an ambiguity, and no sentence permits it. R3 failed because npm run report and RELEASE=1 npm run build are phase 0 commands of 7.7 and the fix being tested is from phase 4. R4 does not apply, since no oracle quantity is involved. R5 failed because 7.3 and 7.7 are not [D], no section 10 default applies, and the P4 decision is scoped to postbuild with a stated reason that the behaviour contradicts. R6 failed because there is no record in gate-G5.md, no P5 merge report, and the P4 leftover gap has a different cause. Minor fits: the SPEC states nothing here, and the gap is in a check whose record claims more than it covers.
